title: Martha's Rule rolled out at every A&E department in England
description: The rule is named after 13-year-old Martha Mills, whose family's concerns about her care were not listened to before her death.

title: Borrowing surge puts pressure on chancellor ahead of Budget
description: Borrowing was higher than expected in August as inflation piles pressure on the government ahead of the Budget.

title: Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting
description: In New York, the prime minister will also deliver a speech to the UN General Assembly expected to be focused on AI.

title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with 'defensive' military support, says PM
description: The prime minister says "defensive air-to-air refuelling" is to be provided following a request from Saudi Arabia, after it faced attacks from the Houthis in Yemen.

title: Vet prescription fees capped under rule changes
description: Vets must also tell clients if cheaper medicine is available online as part of the rule updates which surgeries have the coming months to bring in.

title: Scientists discover why Kent meningitis outbreak was so severe
description: The bacteria responsible picked up some new genetic material, say experts.

title: Watch: Six-year-old girl from China sets new Rubik's Cube world record
description: Lian Yunzhi broke the women's world record twice in three days at World Cube Association competitions.

title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
description: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

title: Watch: Ukraine's race to counter new jet-powered Russian drones
description: Russia's new drones are harder to intercept, making recent attacks on Ukraine even more devastating.
